title.en: Patient instruction for owners and dogs

text.en: Clients emphasize the patience and knowledge demonstrated by head trainer Albert and his instructional team throughout training programs. Dog owners appreciate that coaches take the time to instruct handlers alongside their pets, ensuring families possess the skills to maintain good behavior at home.

Reviewers report significant behavioral turnarounds after completing board-and-train courses or private lessons. Handlers note that high-energy breeds and previously fearful dogs develop reliable recall, better leash manners, and improved confidence when exposed to unfamiliar environments.

Dog owners highlight the calm and attentive handling provided to energetic working dogs such as Belgian Malinois. Families feel at ease leaving their pets at the facility, observing that dogs return home well-balanced, comfortable around people, and free from excessive nervousness.

q.en: What training formats are available at Connor Canine Training?

a.en: The facility offers board-and-train packages, private obedience sessions, and group training presentations.

q.en: Are dog owners involved in the instruction process?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that trainers spend dedicated time educating owners so training commands can be reinforced at home.

q.en: Can the facility handle stubborn or high-energy dogs?

a.en: Clients mention successful outcomes with high-drive working breeds, noting substantial improvements in focus and temperament.
